entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: a desert camel stable. One long rectangular whitewashed mudbrick stable with tall walls, wider than tall, a flat roof with a low stepped parapet, no dome, two tall arched stable doorways on the long side, a timber shade canopy on posts over one doorway, a stone water trough and a turquoise cloth awning.
